face.name: 欧恩哈拉
face.text: 在你的回合结束时，&使用你牌库顶的3张牌。
face.flavorText: 欧恩哈拉的风之力深受牛头人和半人马的崇拜，惠泽甚广，延续至今。

face.name: Ohn'ahra
face.text: At the end of your turn,& play the top 3 cards from your deck.
face.flavorText: Revered by the tauren and centaur, Ohn’ahra’s power over wind remains an inspiration to many.

face.name: 萨恩诺斯巨兽
face.text: 亡语：随机召唤两个法力值消耗为（1）的随从。 使你的随从获得+3攻击力。
face.flavorText: 如果一个虚空生物从虚空中现身，而且名字里不带生僻字，那可真是太可怕了。

face.name: Xel'noth Behemoth
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon two random 1-Cost minions. Give your minions +3 Attack.
face.flavorText: It would be truly terrifying if a void creature came forth from the void with an un-apostrophized name.

face.name: 精灵弓箭手
face.text: 战吼：造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 媚眼如丝，轻盈如燕，致命如箭。

face.name: Elven Archer
face.text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage.
face.flavorText: Don't bother asking her out on a date. She'll shoot you down.

face.name: 巫医
face.text: 战吼： 恢复 2点生命值。
face.flavorText: 别以为带上大坏蛋面具，再把两根筷子插在嘴里，你就是巫医了，伙计。

face.name: Voodoo Doctor
face.text: Battlecry: Restore 2 Health.
face.flavorText: Voodoo is an oft-misunderstood art. But it is art.

face.name: 火羽精灵
face.text: 战吼：将一张1/2的元素牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 拿着空瓶的孩子们，是他们的天敌。

face.name: Fire Fly
face.text: Battlecry: Add a 1/2 Elemental to your hand.
face.flavorText: Archnemeses: small children with glass jars.

face.name: 始生幼龙
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：&对所有其他随从造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 它的一副公鸭嗓让自己在族群里独树一帜。

face.name: Primordial Drake
face.text: Taunt Battlecry:& Deal 2 damage to all other minions.
face.flavorText: Before he became a rap artist.

face.name: 琥珀守卫
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&随机召唤一个来自过去的随从。
face.flavorText: 对于琥珀守卫而言，这是生命中最重要的时刻。对于我而言，那不过是第八回合。

face.name: Amber Warden
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle:& Summon a random minion from the past.
face.flavorText: For Amber Warden, this was the most important moment in their life. For me, it was turn eight.

face.name: 锈烂蝰蛇
face.text: 可交易。战吼：&摧毁对手的武器。
face.flavorText: 这也是剧毒，针对武器的剧毒。

face.name: Rustrot Viper
face.text: Tradeable Battlecry:& Destroy your opponent's weapon.
face.flavorText: Poisonous to weapons.

face.name: 蒸汽清洁器
face.text: 战吼：摧毁双方玩家牌库中所有套牌之外的牌。
face.flavorText: 自从心能短缺，工作清闲了下来。地上迸溅的心能少多了！

face.name: Steamcleaner
face.text: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.
face.flavorText: Business is slow since the anima shortage began. Things just don't get stained like they used to!

face.name: 战场通灵师
face.text: 在你的回合结束时，&将一份残骸复活为1/3并具有嘲讽的复活的步兵。
face.flavorText: 敬请期待：手牌通灵师和牌库通灵师。

face.name: Battlefield Necromancer
face.text: At the end of your turn,& raise a Corpse as a 1/3 Risen Footman with Taunt.
face.flavorText: Coming soon: the Hand Necromancer and the Deck Necromancer.
